title: ultraperformance-official
description: A powerful server-side optimization and anti-bot plugin for Paper and Purpur servers.
body:
# ⚡ UltraPerformance — The Ultimate Server-Side Optimization Suite

**UltraPerformance** is a lightweight, all-in-one performance enhancement and security plugin designed specifically for high-traffic **PaperMC** and **Purpur** servers (1.21.1+). 

Instead of cluttering your server with dozens of unoptimized plugins, UltraPerformance unifies cutting-edge algorithmic improvements inspired by the most famous Fabric optimization mods, adapting them seamlessly into safe Server-Side logic.

---

## 🚀 Core Optimization Modules

### 🔹 Chunk & Lighting Engine (*Lithium & Starlight Inspired*)
* **Asynchronous Lighting:** Offloads heavy block and chunk lighting updates to background threads, preventing main-thread stuttering.
* **Cascade Suppression:** Dynamically blocks redundant block-change cascades, saving precious CPU cycles during heavy world interactions.

### 🔹 Intelligent Entity Culling (*Entity Culling & Dynamic FPS Inspired*)
* **AI Throttling:** Smartly freezes pathfinding and collision checks for mobs inside chunks with no active players.
* **Whitelist System:** Fully customizable whitelist (Players, Villagers, Armor Stands) to guarantee your server mechanics and farms never break.

### 🔹 Memory & Asset Management (*FerriteCore & Memory Leak Fix Inspired*)
* **Garbage Collection Hints:** Automatically triggers lightweight memory sweeps during low-player activity to keep RAM usage stable.
* **Metadata Purging:** Forces clean-ups of orphaned tile-entity and chunk section metadata upon unloading, completely stopping long-term memory leaks.

### 🔹 Smooth Loading & Network Packet Optimizer (*LazyDFU & FastLoad Inspired*)
* **Asynchronous Login Preload:** Caches chunks around player login or teleport coordinates *before* spawning them, wiping out "Join Lag Spikes."
* **Packet Batching:** Compresses and batches massive entity metadata packets sent to distant clients, optimizing the network thread.

---

## 🛡️ 24/7 Security & Watchdog Guard

* **Intelligent Anti-Bot Protection:** Intercepts sudden network connection spikes at the pre-login stage using lightweight packet challenges. Drops malicious bot attacks *before* they can load player data or impact the main thread.
* **Anti-Lag Crash Guard (TPS Watchdog):** Constantly monitors TPS and MSPT. If the server enters emergency status (TPS < 12), it automatically toggles configurable safety measures (pausing chunk generation, freezing item physics, reducing view distance) until the server recovers.

---

## ⚙️ Fully Customizable Configuration

Every single feature, threshold, radius, and module can be toggled and tweaked via the `config.yml` file to fit your server's exact hardware capabilities and player base needs.

## 🛠️ Supported Platforms
* **PaperMC** (1.21.1 and higher)
* **Purpur** (1.21.1 and higher) — Fully compatible with native Purpur performance methods.
